notes: The prompt alias is POS_DEAD with no minimum level and reaches the shared do_display handler (R1/R2/R5e).
An empty argument reaches C's exact usage response after skip_spaces (R1/R3/R5e).
The all branch emits the exact Okay acknowledgement after enabling all five display flags (R1/R3/R5e).
The on spelling is C's all-flags alias and emits Okay (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
The off branch clears all five display flags and returns without an acknowledgement (R1/R3/R5e).
The general loop clears first and enables only recognized h/m/v bits in the focused state test (R1/R3/R5e).
The none input clears all five flags, recognizes no letters, and still emits Okay (R1/R3/R5e).
Focused state assertions pin the all/off/hmv/none transitions and prevent the former custom-prompt reimplementation from returning (R1/R4/R5e).
